description: This line plot illustrates the comparison between "Initial Accuracy" and "Final Accuracy" across varying levels of "o_pop frequency (x10^4)". The x-axis represents the "o_pop frequency (x10^4)" on a linear scale, ranging from 1 to 19 with tick marks at regular intervals of 2. The y-axis represents "Accuracy" on a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The plot features two lines, both of which include vertical error bars at each data point. The "Initial Accuracy" is depicted by a solid green line with square markers. It begins at an accuracy of approximately 0.34 at an x-value of 1, rises to a local peak of roughly 0.49 at x=5, declines to about 0.30 at x=7, and then climbs to its highest point of approximately 0.52 at x=13 before dropping to 0.36 at x=17 and ending at roughly 0.41 at x=19. The "Final Accuracy" is represented by a dashed blue line with circular markers. It starts at approximately 0.65 at x=1, increases to about 0.86 at x=5, dips to roughly 0.72 at x=7, and reaches a peak of approximately 0.91 at x=9. It then experiences a decline to a local minimum of about 0.68 at x=13, followed by a rise to roughly 0.90 at x=15, a drop to 0.82 at x=17, and concludes at approximately 0.90 at x=19.
